# Spec (generated; do not edit)

**Production studio for YouTube channels: niche radar, Kanban projects, AI scriptwriter, 30s comparator, RSS news, media library, advertising and Remotion template engine.**  (size G)

**Users:** visitante: unauthenticated; accesses only login, signup (if open) and password recovery; criador: authenticated user who owns their own data under usuarios/{uid}; admin: user with is_admin=true; reads/writes everything and accesses /admin and audit

**Scope:** authentication with MFA; per-user documents via fs API; file upload; niche radar; projects with wizard and versions; scriptwriter and comparator via Gemini; RSS news; media library; advertising campaigns; Remotion templates and rendering; admin panel with audit

**Out of scope:** subscription payment/billing; organization multi-tenancy; direct upload to YouTube; e-mail/push notifications; real-time multiuser comments/collaboration; native mobile app

## contas (CON) - Signup, login, sessions, TOTP MFA, reauthentication and password recovery.
- **User**: id, email, pass_hash, display_name, email_verified, is_admin, mfa_secret
- **Session**: token, user_id, expires_at, reauth_at
- **PendingLogin**: ticket, user_id, purpose, expires_at
- **PasswordReset**: token, user_id, expires_at
- States User: unverified -> verified
- States PendingLogin: issued -> consumed | expired
- `CON-R01` Signup is only allowed if SIGNUP_OPEN=true or if no user exists yet (bootstrap)
- `CON-R02` Signup requires non-empty e-mail and password with a minimum of 6 characters
- `CON-R03` E-mail is normalized (lowercase, trim) and unique; duplicate returns 409
- `CON-R04` is_admin goes to the bootstrap (1st user) or whoever signs up with the ADMIN_EMAIL e-mail
- `CON-R05` Login returns 401 'Credenciais inválidas' for unknown e-mail or wrong password, without distinguishing
- `CON-R08` Session lasts SESSION_DAYS days (default 30); accepts vysc_sess cookie, Bearer or ?token=
- `CON-R10` Password reset creates a 1h token and replies with a generic message even if the e-mail does not exist
- `CON-R11` Confirming reset consumes the token, updates the password and deletes all user sessions
- `CON-R12` Logout deletes the current session in the database and expires the vysc_sess cookie
- `CON-R13` verify-email sets email_verified=true; debug link only appears with DEV_MODE=true
- `CON-R14` Session cookie uses Secure only on HTTPS and SameSite=None on HTTPS, Lax on HTTP
- `CON-R15` Password is persisted as PBKDF2-SHA256, 100k iterations, format pbkdf2_sha256$iter$salt$hash
- `CON-R17` Identity comes from the validated session; a uid sent by the client is ignored
- `CON-R18` Each user has a membros/{uid} doc with role, plan and status managed by admin

## mfa (MFA) - TOTP two-factor authentication: enrollment, single-use tickets and reauthentication.
- **TotpSecret**: secret, owner
- **PendingLogin**: ticket, user_id, purpose, expires_at
- States PendingLogin: issued -> consumed | expired
- `MFA-R01` With MFA enabled, login returns mfaRequired and a 5-minute ticket instead of creating a session
- `MFA-R02` MFA ticket is single-use, expires in 5 minutes and has purpose 'login' or 'reauth'
- `MFA-R03` mfa/start, mfa/enroll and mfa/unenroll require reauthentication within the last 10 minutes
- `MFA-R04` A wrong TOTP code returns 401 without consuming the ticket; only a valid code consumes it
- `MFA-R05` mfa/enroll only stores the secret on the user after validating a correct TOTP code
- `MFA-R06` mfa/start issues a new TOTP secret without persisting; persistence happens only on enroll
- `MFA-R07` mfa/reauth with a valid ticket and code updates the session's reauth_at

## plataforma (PLA) - Path-based data model: collections, documents, permissions, merge, sentinels and events.
- **Doc**: path, coll, parent, uid, data, created_at, updated_at
- **FileMeta**: path, uid, name, content_type, size, disk
- **AuditEvent**: id, user_id, action, detail, created_at
- `PLA-R02` Document path alternates collection/doc; odd segments address collections
- `PLA-R03` Admin reads and writes any document, collection and file in the system
- `PLA-R04` Non-admin only reads/writes docs under usuarios/{own-uid}/; planos and aulas are authenticated reads
- `PLA-R05` The erros collection accepts creation by any authenticated user, but no later read or write
- `PLA-R06` The membros/{uid} document can only be written by the user who owns the uid
- `PLA-R11` Collection listing accepts where field|op|value, orderBy field[:desc] and limit>0
- `PLA-R16` setDoc with merge:true performs a deep merge; without merge the document is replaced
- `PLA-R17` Sentinels: __del deletes the field, __svts writes server timestamp, __inc adds to the current value
- `PLA-R18` GET on a missing document returns the doc with exists:false and HTTP 200
- `PLA-R19` Created document IDs are random tokens generated by the backend (authx.Token(8))
- `PLA-R20` Permissions are evaluated at the path root; subcollections inherit the top-level rule
- `PLA-R21` POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE on docs publish an SSE event with the changed path

## transporte (TRN) - API HTTP layer: session, upload, RSS proxy, SSE, SPA fallback and public endpoints.
- **Request**: method, path, sessao
- `TRN-R01` Every /api/v1/* data route requires a valid session; without a session returns 401
- `TRN-R02` Files exist only under usuarios/{uid}/; access limited to own uid or admin
- `TRN-R03` Upload exceeding UPLOAD_MAX_MB (default 512MB) returns 413
- `TRN-R04` GET /api/feed proxies an arbitrary http(s) URL: 8s timeout, max 2MB body, 5min cache
- `TRN-R05` SSE /api/v1/fs/events requires read permission on the path and sends keepalive every 25s
- `TRN-R06` Session can come from vysc_sess cookie, Bearer header or ?token query (used by SSE)
- `TRN-R07` Unknown /api/* route returns JSON 404; unknown SPA routes serve index.html with 404
- `TRN-R08` GET /api/feed and /feed require a valid session; without a session returns 401
- `TRN-R09` Proxy /api/render, /api/rendered and /api/gemini/* require session; anonymous returns 401
- `TRN-R10` Media /rendered/, /thumbnails/, /previews/, /rendercomp-thumbs/ is public (catalog /templates, P11)
- `TRN-R11` Media /cache/ requires session; anonymous returns 401

## navegacao (NAV) - SPA routes, session guards, deep links, returnTo and 404 fallback.
- **Rota**: path, view, privada
- `NAV-R01` Private route without a session redirects to /entrar?returnTo=<current path>
- `NAV-R02` returnTo must start with '/', not start with '//' and not contain '://' (anti open redirect)
- `NAV-R03` Internal navigation uses history.pushState; back/forward sync screen and URL
- `NAV-R04` '/' shows the public LandingView; a logged-in user is redirected to /visao-geral
- `NAV-R05` /templates, /templates/ai-studio and /templates/motion-library are public (no PrivateRoute)
- `NAV-R06` Unknown route renders NotFoundView; backend serves index.html with 404 status (TRN-R07)
- `NAV-R07` Deep links /projetos/{id}, /canais/{id}, /radar/perfis/{id} and /templates/{id} open the resource directly
- `NAV-R08` /admin/{tab} syncs the panel tab with the URL (membros, aulas, planos, erros)
- `NAV-R09` Route change reads the query string; /pesquisa?q=<term> syncs the search field

## radar (RAD) - Niche/topic monitoring profiles with signals, hot topics and competition.
- **RadarPerfil**: nome, nicho, formato, aceleracao, taxaOutliers, viewsMedias7d, concorrencia, sinais, topicosQuentes, ultimoSinalAt
- `RAD-R01` Radar profile requires non-empty nome; blank nicho defaults to 'Geral'
- `RAD-R02` On creation, taxaOutliers defaults to 2.0 and viewsMedias7d to 25000 if not provided
- `RAD-R03` Every new profile starts with concorrencia 'Média'
- `RAD-R04` sinais receives the provided initial signal or the default manual-entry text
- `RAD-R05` Profile list updates in real time via SSE on the radar_perfis collection
- `RAD-R06` Profiles live in usuarios/{uid}/radar_perfis — isolated per user (PLA-R04)
- `RAD-R07` Cluster normalization groups signals and topics by calling POST /api/v1/ai/action
- `RAD-R08` Search filters profiles by nome or nicho containing the term, case-insensitive
- `RAD-R09` Profile can become a project source via origemRadarId in the wizard (see PRJ-R07)

## projetos (PRJ) - Video projects on a Kanban with a 4-step wizard, checklist and versioning.
- **Projeto**: titulo, canalNome, estagio, formato, prioridade, dataPublicacaoAlvo, ctrAlvo, conceitoThumbnail, ganchoResumo, origemRadarId, checklist, versaoAtual
- **ChecklistItem**: id, texto, feito
- **Versao**: versao, autor, resumoMudanca, conteudo
- States Projeto: ideacao -> roteiro -> gravacao -> edicao -> publicado
- `PRJ-R01` Project requires non-empty titulo; blank canalNome defaults to 'Canal Principal'
- `PRJ-R02` Creation wizard has 4 steps: Channel & Format, Packaging & Hook, Pipeline & Checklist, Review
- `PRJ-R03` ctrAlvo defaults to 8.0 when empty or non-numeric
- `PRJ-R04` Every project starts with versaoAtual=1 and a versoes/v1 doc with author and creation summary
- `PRJ-R05` Initial checklist items become sequential chk_N with feito=false
- `PRJ-R06` Projects live in usuarios/{uid}/projetos — isolated per user (PLA-R04)
- `PRJ-R07` Optional origemRadarId links the project to a radar profile
- `PRJ-R08` estagio belongs to {ideacao, roteiro, gravacao, edicao, publicado} and changes via Kanban patch
- `PRJ-R09` Project deletion is physical (document DELETE), no trash

## roteirista (ROT) - Script generation via Gemini with writer profiles, chapters and saving.
- **Roteiro**: title, summary, formato, canal, categoria, chapters, geradoEm
- **WriterProfile**: nome, tom, estilo, audiencia, prompt
- `ROT-R01` Generation requires topic, channelName, niche, audience, format, tone, durationMinutes and hookStyle
- `ROT-R02` The format field only accepts 'long' or 'shorts'
- `ROT-R03` Generated script opens with the hook chapter '00 — Hook (00:00 – 00:30)'
- `ROT-R04` Writer profiles live in usuarios/{uid}/config/roteirista_perfis
- `ROT-R05` Saved scripts live in usuarios/{uid}/roteiros — isolated per user
- `ROT-R06` Generation uses POST /api/v1/ai/script on the Go backend, which calls Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash)
- `ROT-R07` Optional profilePrompt and knowledgeBase customize the model output

## comparador (CMP) - A/B comparison of 30-second hooks via Gemini, with saved result.
- **Comparacao**: titleA, hookA, visualCutsA, titleB, hookB, visualCutsB, niche, winner, edge, analise
- `CMP-R01` Comparison requires titleA, hookA, visualCutsA, titleB, hookB, visualCutsB and niche
- `CMP-R02` Result declares winner and edge, each one ∈ {A, B, empate}
- `CMP-R03` Saved comparisons live in usuarios/{uid}/comparacoes — isolated per user
- `CMP-R04` Comparison uses POST /api/v1/ai/compare-30s on the Go backend, which calls Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash)

## noticias (NOT) - RSS/Atom feed reading, AI article translation and conversion into assignments.
- **FeedItem**: title, link, publishedAt, summary
- **Nota**: titulo, texto, origem
- `NOT-R01` Feed is fetched via GET /api/feed?url= on the backend proxy, not directly by the client (TRN-R04)
- `NOT-R02` Parser accepts RSS <item> items and Atom <entry> entries; missing title becomes 'Sem título'
- `NOT-R03` Summary comes from the feed item's description or content:encoded
- `NOT-R04` Article translation uses POST /api/v1/ai/action 'translate:article'
- `NOT-R05` Converting news into an assignment creates a doc in usuarios/{uid}/ideias titled 'Pauta Notícia: <título>' (IDE-R03)
- `NOT-R06` Feed larger than 2MB is rejected with 413 and a URL without http/https with 400 (TRN-R04)

## midia (MID) - Media library: upload/list/download/delete of files and saved reference videos.
- **FileMeta**: path, uid, name, content_type, size, disk, created_at
- **VideoSalvo**: titulo, tituloPt, canal, url, duracao, motivoSalvo, categoria
- `MID-R01` Upload is PUT /api/v1/files/{path} only under usuarios/{uid}/ (TRN-R02)
- `MID-R02` content_type uses ?ct=, then the request Content-Type, otherwise 'application/octet-stream'
- `MID-R03` GET /api/v1/files/{path} returns metadata; ?download=1 or /download suffix serves the binary
- `MID-R04` DELETE /api/v1/files/{path} removes the metadata and deletes the file from disk
- `MID-R05` GET /api/v1/files?prefix= lists items and prefixes; empty prefix defaults to usuarios/{uid}
- `MID-R06` Saved video requires non-empty titulo; blank canal defaults to 'Referência'
- `MID-R07` Batch translation writes tituloPt on saved videos via ai.action 'translate:titles'
- `MID-R08` File paths are normalized; '..' and '.' are removed without escaping the user's prefix

## biblioteca (BIB) - User file browser: folders, upload, download and media organization.
- **Pasta**: prefix
- **FileItem**: path, name, contentType, size
- `BIB-R01` Library browses the usuarios/{uid} prefix via /api/v1/files?prefix= (MID-R05)
- `BIB-R02` Subfolders are created implicitly by the upload path
- `BIB-R03` Upload into the current folder uses PUT /api/v1/files/{prefix}/{nome} (MID-R01)
- `BIB-R04` Listing separates files (items) from subfolders (prefixes)

## canais (CAN) - Own and reference channels with metrics and AI strategic analysis.
- **Canal**: nome, handle, nicho, tipo, inscritos, views30d, ctrMedio, retencaoMedia, frequenciaSemanal, descricao, analiseIa
- `CAN-R01` Channel has type 'proprio' or 'referencia'; /meus-canais filters type other than 'referencia'
- `CAN-R02` Channels live in usuarios/{uid}/canais — isolated per user (PLA-R04)
- `CAN-R03` Channel metrics: inscritos, views30d, ctrMedio, retencaoMedia and frequenciaSemanal
- `CAN-R04` Strategic analysis uses POST /api/v1/ai/action 'channel:analyze' and stores the result in analiseIa

## ideias (IDE) - Video idea bank fed by news, AI assistant and manual entry (/explorar).
- **Ideia**: titulo, nicho, potencial, origem, notas
- `IDE-R01` Idea records titulo, nicho, potencial, origem and notas
- `IDE-R02` Ideas live in usuarios/{uid}/ideias — isolated per user (PLA-R04)
- `IDE-R03` Converted news becomes an idea with titulo 'Pauta Notícia: <título>', origem 'Notícias RSS', potencial 'alto'

## notas (NTA) - Free-form studio notes with category and pinned flag.
- **Nota**: titulo, categoria, conteudo, fixada
- `NTA-R01` Note requires non-empty titulo to be saved
- `NTA-R02` Note is created with fixada=false
- `NTA-R03` Notes live in usuarios/{uid}/notas — isolated per user (PLA-R04)

## playbook (PLY) - Editorial playbook: retention rules extracted from 30s comparisons, organized by category.
- **Regra**: categoria, titulo, regra, impacto
- `PLY-R01` Each '[category] rule' line of a 30s comparison checklist becomes a playbook doc
- `PLY-R02` A line without a '[category]' prefix is classified as 'retencao'
- `PLY-R03` Saved rule stores titulo '<CATEGORY> — 30s Comparison (<niche>)' and impacto citing sides A and B
- `PLY-R04` Rules live in usuarios/{uid}/playbook — isolated per user (PLA-R04)

## pesquisa (PES) - Client-side global search over projects, channels, notes and radar profiles (/pesquisa).
- **Resultado**: tipo, titulo, subtitulo, to
- `PES-R01` Search covers 4 collections: the user's projetos, canais, notas and radar_perfis
- `PES-R02` Each result carries tipo (Projeto|Canal|Nota|Radar), titulo, subtitulo and a link to the entity route
- `PES-R03` Filter is case-insensitive and matches titulo, subtitulo or tipo
- `PES-R04` Query string ?q= syncs the search term with the URL (NAV-R09)
- `PES-R05` Empty search lists all items from the 4 collections

## publicidade (PUB) - Registry of advertising and sponsorship campaigns per channel, with negotiation status.
- **Campanha**: marca, canalNome, status, formato, valorAcordado, prazoEntrega, entregaveis
- `PUB-R01` Campaign requires non-empty marca to be registered
- `PUB-R02` Every new campaign starts with status 'negociacao'
- `PUB-R03` Blank valorAcordado defaults to 'A definir'
- `PUB-R04` Campaign status is updated via PATCH on the document
- `PUB-R05` Campaigns live in usuarios/{uid}/publicidade — isolated per user (PLA-R04)
- `PUB-R06` Empty list shows the 'No advertising campaigns registered' state

## configuracoes (CFG) - User preferences (visual theme) and application runtime configuration.
- **PrefDoc**: tema
- **RuntimeConfig**: fields exposed by /api/v1/auth/config
- `CFG-R01` User theme is stored in usuarios/{uid}/config/app in the tema field
- `CFG-R02` Theme is only applied if it exists in the TEMAS registry; invalid value falls back to 'claro'
- `CFG-R03` Without login or doc, theme comes from localStorage 'vysc_tema' with 'claro' fallback
- `CFG-R04` On login, the remote doc theme overwrites localStorage
- `CFG-R05` Runtime config comes from GET /api/v1/auth/config — public; adminEmailHint only in DEV_MODE

## dashboard (DSH) - Overview (/visao-geral): aggregations of channels, projects, advertising and radar.
- **Overview**: canais, projetos, publicidade, radar_perfis
- `DSH-R01` Overview aggregates the user's canais, projetos, publicidade and radar_perfis collections
- `DSH-R02` meusCanais excludes channels with type 'referencia' from the sums
- `DSH-R03` totalInscritos and totalViews30d sum the fields of own channels
- `DSH-R04` projetosAtivos are projects with estagio other than 'publicado'
- `DSH-R05` publisPendentes are campaigns with status other than 'concluida'
- `DSH-R06` The overview opens the project creation wizard (PRJ-R02)

## render (REN) - Remotion + Gemini render service: parameterized templates become mp4 and media.
- **RenderJob**: templateId, compositionId, props, resolution, codec
- **RenderedVideo**: filename, videoUrl, sizeBytes, createdAt
- **TemplateFamily**: id, registry, componente
- States RenderJob: received -> rendering -> completed | failed
- `REN-R01` POST /api/render accepts templateId or compositionId, props, resolution and codec (default h264)
- `REN-R02` resolution '720p' uses --scale=0.6666666666666666, '4K' uses --scale=2, others no scale
- `REN-R03` Empty templateId uses StepProcessInfographic; an unknown one is used literally
- `REN-R04` Output is render_<compositionId>_<timestamp>.mp4 in MEDIA_DIR/rendered, served at /rendered/
- `REN-R05` Without an output file, returns 500 with stderr embedded in the error message
- `REN-R06` GET /api/rendered lists mp4 files ordered by createdAt descending
- `REN-R07` /api/gemini/generate-script requires topic and produces scene JSON with gemini-2.5-flash
- `REN-R08` Go backend proxies /api/render, /api/rendered and /api/gemini/* to RENDER_SERVICE_URL
- `REN-R09` Go serves MEDIA_DIR media at prefixes /rendered/ /thumbnails/ /previews/ /rendercomp-thumbs/ /cache/
- `REN-R10` Render invokes bunx @remotion/cli with a 600s timeout and concurrency=8
- `REN-R11` Library has ~100 template families in src/remotion-templates/remotion/families

## Non-functional
- `NF01` Go backend serves API + SPA in a single binary; local SQLite database via DATABASE_URL
- `NF02` RSS feed: 8s timeout, max 2MB body, in-memory cache for 5min
- `NF03` File upload limited to UPLOAD_MAX_MB MB (default 512)
- `NF04` Remotion render executed by a separate service (:8090), 600s timeout, mp4 output in MEDIA_DIR/rendered
- `NF05` SSE keepalive every 25s; doc change events propagated by path
- `NF06` Session via HttpOnly cookie + Bearer; 32-byte session token, SESSION_DAYS days (default 30)
- `NF07` Go backend tested with `go test ./...` in backend-go before each delivery
- `NF08` Database queries use parameterized SQL; API responses are JSON
- `NF09` API errors respond with JSON {error: message} and a semantic HTTP code

## Assumptions (assumed, unconfirmed)
- `P01` AI endpoints require GEMINI_API_KEY in the backend; without the key they respond 503
- `P02` Single-user or few-user instance (SIGNUP_OPEN=false by default; first signup becomes admin)
- `P03` LGPD applies only to account e-mail/name; app collects no sensitive data nor targets minors
- `P04` Gemini called via @google/genai with GEMINI_API_KEY from the environment; model gemini-2.5-flash
- `P05` Dates persisted as epoch ms UTC; formatted display on the client
- `P06` Embedded SQL migrations run at Go binary boot (migrations/ embed)
- `P07` FKs with ON DELETE CASCADE tie sessions, MFA tickets and resets to the user
- `P08` UI in pt-BR without i18n; localized formats on the client
- `P09` DEV_MODE/USE_MOCK_DATA seeds demo data at boot (seed.go), including admin
- `P10` Indexes on docs(coll), docs(parent), docs(uid) and files(uid) for listings
- `P11` Public media folders mix catalog assets and user renders; per-uid separation left as debt
